blurb: Guests can enjoy a variety of craft beers in a family-friendly taproom with games like Crokinole. The brewery offers a private event room for up to 40 people with flexible layout and BYOF food options. They also host a casual disc golf league on weekends with social gatherings at the brewery.
extraNote: Half of the hourly payment is due upfront to confirm reservation · No glitter or confetti allowed in decorations · Guests can bring their own food or have it catered; no kitchen on-site · Taproom at 2121 Ogden Ave., Unit A, Lisle, IL
